versions.content: If development error detection is enabled the function Icu_SetActivationCondition shall check the parameter Activation. The function Icu_SetActivationCondition shall raise the error ICU_E_PARAM_ACTIVATION if Activation is invalid but only for the requested ICU channel. SWS_Icu_00022 apply to the function Icu_SetActivationCondition.
